title: What V witnessed
summary: The bridge groups what the game's own systems raise (stimuli, deaths, combat targets, reprimands, vehicle thefts, combat and fear barks) into incidents and sends one passive witness.report per incident V saw or heard, with its id, kind, people, place and times.
priority_reason: Story Engine S7 (M4): layer 3's gates need incidents linked to V. Borg 4 passed WI; the remaining WI rows run next.

demand.note: One passive report per incident V saw, heard or was told of, carrying the incident's identity, who took part, where, when and how V perceived it.
Part of the world event feed: combat, deaths and crimes near V, grouped.

limits: 32 open incidents, 64 kept; 24 observations built a second (12 weak, 2 of one kind from one entity) and 40 accepted.
20 reports a minute with a queue of 64; a witness.gap event when even that is full; a 160 m gate before any work.
Saw: a person other than V in the active camera's view within 80 m with no static geometry on the ray; heard: V inside the stimulus' own radius.
quirks: Was told is never sensed and never reported.
The game raises almost none of the Story Engine's incident kinds (no NPC theft, no stall collection); its only theft is V's own vehicle theft, so most incidents must be staged and declared.

unknowns.question: Which WI rows did Borg 4's PASS cover? The findings record WI as passed without naming rows.
unknowns.settle_by: Name the rows in the next session's write-up

notes: Autonomous build only; passive and read-only (nothing is sent into the game).

title: Observation taps
summary: Taps on the game's own producing systems (stimulus broadcasts, deaths and defeats, combat targets, reprimands, vehicle thefts, combat and fear barks) hand small observations to the plugin's incident core.

rows.note: The tap is live and quiet.

notes: Located in the 2.31 scripts; the prevention system reacts only to V's crimes and is not a source.

title: Declared incidents
summary: incidents.declare opens an incident the Story Engine stages with its own XF actors, carrying the engine's id, kind and roles; V's sight of its actors is sampled while it is open, and closing gives exactly one witness.report, witness.unwitnessed or witness.gap.
priority_reason: Story Engine S7 (M4) and the scene layer's one declared incident per scene; DI2 and DI3 passed in Borg 4, DI1 and DI4 to DI12 are next.

demand.note: Declared incidents: the engine's own id, kind and actor roles at staging start; exactly one outcome when it closes.
Closed bookkeeping: a scene that gives up closes its declared incident, so it ends in exactly one report, unwitnessed outcome or gap.

limits: At most four declared incidents at once; V's sight sampled twice a second, at most three samples a second accepted.
Only XF actors (a1 …) are named; V and picked passers-by are refused.
quirks: Ordinary incidents that share people merge into a declared one and keep its id and kind; strangers nearby do not join.

title: Actors joining an incident
summary: npc.spawn and npc.substitute take incident and incident_role, so a new actor joins a declared incident before anything is sent to the game.
